text:
anya: quick decision needed: final response envelope for GA. customers asking for explicit billing units and deterministic traces.
chris: agree. keep top-level small: `request_id`, `trace_id`, `model`, `usage`, `billing_units`, `result`.
devon: suggested `usage.tokens_total|prompt|completion` and optional `usage.per_message` gated by param `expand_token_breakdown=true` (size caps).
pm_jordan: launch must-have: SDK updates, migration notes, console telemetry, legal signoff on retention/PII.
sre_maya: trace format: prefix `rwd-` + hex, must appear in access logs. sampling 100% errors, 1% successes.
anya: tool calls live under `result.tools` with `stdout`/`structured` and `content_digest` for large payloads. rerank under `result.rerank.items` with `item_id,score,normalized_score`.
chris: embedding sample: `result.embedding = {vector:[...],dims:1536,model:"embed-1",metadata:{source_id:"..."}}`.
devon: add `billing_units_type` string for finance mapping. include `billing_units` float for direct billing.
infra-bot: scheduling canary flag `usage_envelope_v1` 2024-11-06T09:00Z on canary-2.
anya: action owners: chris/devon schema PR, pm_jordan comms/playbook, sre_maya logging. follow-up next Tue.
pm_jordan: marking priority=high for next sprint if no objections. :white_check_mark:
